description: This file defines configuration for caching in the Apache Fineract project, including cache managers, cache configuration generation, and auto-detection of caches via reflection.

classes.name: CacheConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for setting up cache managers and cache configurations in a Spring application for Fineract.

methods.name: defaultCacheManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a TransactionBoundCacheManager with a delegate to ehCacheManager and NoOpCacheManager.

methods.name: ehCacheManager
methods.description: Creates and configures JCacheCacheManager with internal Ehcache CacheManager.

methods.name: getInternalEhCacheManager
methods.description: Sets up the Ehcache CacheManager, scans classpath for @Cacheable annotations, and registers caches accordingly.

methods.name: generateCustomCacheConfiguration
methods.description: Generates cache configuration based on custom cache template settings.

methods.name: generateCacheConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a standard Ehcache configuration with specified max entries and TTL.
